subject: Whether the Section 31 20 00 required compaction density for the structural fill under

messages.text: Does the Section 31 20 00 required compaction density for the structural fill under the building pad shown on Sheet C-101 hold up against the geotechnical report's requirements for this area? This is routine and can be reviewed during the normal submittal cycle. No cost impact is expected from this compliance question. This isn't holding up any current earthwork activity. A response within three days would help us stay ahead of the compaction testing.
The geotechnical report already covers this -- see Detail 6/C-601 for the Section 31 20 00 required compaction density for the structural fill under the building pad. No further action needed.
